About RBCA

A living library for Africa's future

RBCA protects rice diversity for breeding, research, education, and the changing climate.

21,035accessions held
85%originated in Africa
11CGIAR genebanks
The work behind the resource

Protecting diversity means making it useful.

RBCA collects wild accessions, landraces, traditional farmer varieties, and improved varieties across Africa.

Its mandate spans ex situ conservation, safety duplication, monitoring, regeneration, characterization, data management, and distribution to the global rice community.
